get_template.TemplateBody:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Parameters:
  Env:
    Type: String
Resources:
  Fn:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Environment:
        Variables:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: {{CANARY:cfn}}
          DB_SECRET: !Ref DbSecret
